_meta.description: Box's M via TEST_BOX_M: do the four regions share one covariance matrix across revenue_before, revenue and session_minutes? The equal-covariance check before TEST_MANOVA. Box's chi-square is the headline statistic and p-value; M and the F approximation (f, df1, df2, f_p_value) ride details. The test is sensitive to non-normal data, so many read only p < 0.001 as a problem.
